name: Goblin Mage
problem: My fireball spell now creates soup.
success: The fireball works again. Unfortunately the soup is now explosive.
failure: The goblin becomes legally classified as chowder.

name: Skeleton Archer
problem: My left arm disconnected during battle.
solutions: Turn skeleton off and on again
success: The skeleton now has TOO MANY arms.
failure: The skeleton files a workplace complaint.

name: Dragon Accountant
problem: My treasure hoard won't calculate taxes.
success: The kingdom no longer has a tax department.
failure: The dragon discovers spreadsheets.

name: Orc Blacksmith
problem: My anvil is making a weird noise.
solutions: Convince the orc to switch to a different profession
success: The anvil is quiet again, but now it's also very slippery.
failure: The orc's anvil is now classified as a musical instrument.

name: Annoyed Elf
problem: Coworker had turned on Subway surfer on second monitor while working
success: The elf can now focus on work, but is also very confused about why the second monitor is off.
failure: The elf's productivity drops by 50% due to constant distraction.

name: Confused Boss
problem: Jeff Stole all the paper towels and used them to make a sculpture of himself and put it on my desk
solutions: Politely ask Jeff to remove the sculpture
Report Jeff to HR for inappropriate desk decorations
Join Jeff in his paper towel art project
success: Jeff apologizes and removes the sculpture, restoring order to the office.
failure: The boss becomes obsessed with the sculpture and starts a new office trend of paper towel art, leading to a shortage of paper towels for actual use.

name: Addicted Goul
problem: Had to much moss
solutions: Convince goul to switch to a different addiction
success: The goul successfully completes moss rehab and is now addicted to grass instead.
failure: The goul's addiction worsens and it starts hoarding moss, leading to a moss infestation in the office.

name: Ju5tJeff
problem: He didn't know he was in this game
solutions: Tell him he's in the game
Ignore him and hope he figures it out
Convince him to join the game
success: Jeff is surprised but excited to be in the game and starts participating actively.
failure: Jeff remains oblivious to the game and continues to go about his day without any change in behavior.

name: smeagol
problem: He lost his precious
solutions: Convince him to let go of it
Replace it with a new precious
success: Smeagol finds his precious and is overjoyed, but becomes even more obsessed with it.
failure: Smeagol becomes despondent and starts hoarding other shiny objects in an attempt to fill the void left by his lost precious.

name: Wizard Intern
problem: Accidentally turned my supervisor into a coffee mug.
success: The supervisor is restored and immediately schedules a performance review.
failure: The mug becomes department manager.

name: Dungeon Mimic
problem: Nobody opens me anymore.
success: Several adventurers are successfully fooled.
failure: The mimic becomes an influencer.

name: Necromancer
problem: My skeletons formed a union.
success: The new skeletons immediately start a second union.
failure: The skeletons demand dental coverage despite lacking teeth.

name: Village Guard
problem: Arrow took an arrow to the knee.
success: The guard can walk again and won't stop talking about it.
failure: The guard starts a knee collection.

name: Goblin Chef
problem: Customers keep escaping the restaurant.
success: The food is now only mildly poisonous.
failure: The restaurant wins 'Most Secure Dining Experience' award.

name: Crystal Ball Technician
problem: The future keeps buffering.
success: The future is visible again and somehow contains more advertisements.
failure: The technician is stuck in a loading screen.

name: Dwarf Miner
problem: Found too much gold.
success: The dwarf discovers diamonds and a much larger problem.
failure: The gold shortage causes an economic crisis.

name: Town Bard
problem: My latest song is stuck in everyone's head.
success: The bard becomes rich and universally hated.
failure: The entire town communicates exclusively through humming.

name: Evil Overlord
problem: My minions keep calling me 'Bestie'.
solutions: Change your title to Supreme Bestie
success: The minions are terrified again, but morale reaches historic lows.
failure: The annual friendship picnic becomes mandatory.

name: Apprentice Alchemist
problem: Potion turned my cat invisible.
success: The cat is visible again and extremely judgmental.
failure: Nobody knows where the cat is, including the cat.

name: Ancient Lich
problem: Forgot where I put my phylactery.
success: The phylactery was under the couch the whole time.
failure: The lich now has two phylacteries and no idea which is real.

name: Quest Board Manager
problem: Heroes keep accepting quests and never reading the details.
success: Quest completion rates improve dramatically.
failure: The heroes still skip to the rewards section.
